source: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
scope: Indicative registered freehold-property positions and extents, not complete cadastre, all tenures, ownership records or definitive legal boundaries.
adapter: Existing bounded complete GML authority-snapshot reader; no parcel database import.
protocol: gml-snapshot-adapter; two complete fresh 13-cell passes; exact IDs in batches <=80; complete zero-result absence probe
serverPaging: Not applicable to a completely parsed authority ZIP; viewport and exact-ID completeness checked against fresh complete snapshots.
editingAndAuthoritativeBinding: No app integration: excluded sources are not configured, rendered or selectable.

archiveAndEvidenceLimits.sourceScope: Official HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons authority snapshot; title-index polygons, not definitive legal boundaries.
archiveAndEvidenceLimits.transformLimit: OSGB36 conversion uses the adapter Helmert approximation (about 5 m); no OSTN15 grid is applied.
archiveAndEvidenceLimits.temporalLimit: The full authority archive is loaded in transient memory; monthly revisions are accepted only after a complete bounded parse.

metricReview.method: Independent GEOS/Shapely validity, duplicate and full candidate-pair intersection checks on unmodified full WGS84 source polygons projected for metric measurement only.
